name: Prizm
tagline: Your CV and cover letter tailored to every job offer in a minute
description: Prizm helps job seekers apply better without losing their evenings to it. Paste a job offer and Prizm starts with an honest fit verdict: how well your profile matches, what is strong, what is missing. Then you decide whether it is worth applying. If it is, Prizm tailors your CV and cover letter to that offer in under a minute, using only your real background. It never invents experience or skills. Templates are clean and readable by applicant tracking systems (ATS). Free to start (5 applications per week, the verdict is always free), then one-time packs with no subscription. Built in France for graduates, professionals, apprentices and career changers.
